title: inferred finalization ignores process and tool liveness
finding: advance_inferred closes sessions from transcript silence and new_activity only; watcher invokes it unconditionally. A quiet transcript can therefore enter inferred_pending/finalize while the client process is alive or tools are active, violating the required process-disappeared + no-active-tools evidence contract.
impact: Premature finalization can split an active session and trigger extraction/precipitation before the user or host is finished.
verification: PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q: 390 passed; existing tests cover timing and transcript tool_use, but not process liveness.

title: inferred finalization requires explicit liveness evidence
contract: SessionLifecycleEvent carries strict process_alive and active_tools booleans. Missing or invalid values remain unknown. advance_inferred proceeds only when both values are explicitly false and the existing silence/grace/tool-use checks pass. Claude watcher currently has no session-scoped probe, so its default remains conservative and blocks inferred close.

title: workflow metrics use attributable event ledgers
contract: Precipitation confirmation and modification metrics read explicit precipitation_verdicts. Recall error labels require a matching rule-hit session plus request-linked feedback; unknown or unlinked labels are excluded. Existing application attribution remains a separate proxy metric.

title: existing episode activity did not cancel inferred close
finding: new_activity was set only for a previously unseen episode, so appended transcript lines on an existing episode could still advance inferred finalization in the same scan.
fix: Set new_activity after every successful collection of new transcript lines.
verification: Regression added; focused test passed and full suite is 407 passed, 1 skipped.

title: revocation latency used first historical hit
finding: Latency was measured from the first-ever hit for a rule, inflating response time and misattributing later revocations.
fix: Use the latest hit timestamp at or before each revocation feedback event.
verification: Regression added with 30-day-old and 10-minute-old hits; full suite is 407 passed, 1 skipped.

title: Claude inferred finalization has exact session liveness evidence
contract: SessionStart stores the exact Claude ancestor PID and creation time per session. The watcher validates that identity and consumes session-scoped active-tool IDs maintained by UserPromptSubmit/Stop/PreToolUse/PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure hooks. Missing optional psutil, unrecognized ancestry, PID reuse, inaccessible state, or expired tool evidence remain unknown and block inferred finalization. Inferred closure requires both explicit process exit and no active tools plus the silence/grace checks.
verification: PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q: 415 passed, 1 skipped; liveness optional extra is psutil>=5.9,<8.
